text:
I've added English captions to your clip, but I couldn't make it 9:16.

**What you're getting:**
- All 10 seconds, with her original voice unchanged.
- Captions are generated automatically from her speech. They're white text with a black outline, placed at the bottom centre, below her face, so they don't cover her.
- Download (link works for 24 hours): https://videos.magichour.ai/cmwbib9lf04rigq01xiqxiewc/video.mp4?X-Goog-Algorithm=GOOG4-RSA-SHA256&X-Goog-Credential=web-service%40magic-hour-385504.iam.gserviceaccount.com%2F20261111%2Fauto%2Fstorage%2Fgoog4_request&X-Goog-Date=20261111T023634Z&X-Goog-Expires=86400&X-Goog-SignedHeaders=host&X-Goog-

**What's not done: the 9:16 format.** Your clip is landscape (858×480), and so is this captioned version. My tools can't crop or reframe a video. The only tool that could change the shape makes the whole video again with AI, which could change her face and her voice. You asked to keep her voice, so I didn't use it.

If you crop the captioned version to 9:16 yourself, the edges of the captions will be cut off. A better way:
1. Crop your original clip to 9:16, with her in the centre. Any phone editor or CapCut can do this.
2. Send me the cropped clip.
3. I'll add the captions to it, below her face. That's 48 credits, the same as this run.

About your worry that captions might distract from her: I used a plain, small style with no word highlighting or animation, and kept the captions low in the frame, away from her face.
